description: Create a new Godot scene file with a single root node. Writes a fresh .tscn at scenePath. Use when starting a new scene from scratch; for adding nodes to an existing scene, use add_node. rootNodeType defaults to Node2D - pass "Node3D" for 3D scenes or "Control" for UI. Saves automatically. Overwrites silently if the file already exists. Returns: success and the scenePath that was written. Errors while a Godot runtime session is active on this project; stop_project (or detach_project) clears it.

projectPath.description: Path to the Godot project directory

scenePath.description: Scene file path relative to the project (e.g. "scenes/main.tscn")

name: create_scene
